test_title: PYST 5: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - Reasoning (Held On: 13th Sep 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: In each of the following questions, a group of three numbers/symbols is given in each option. Identify the group that does NOT follow the same pattern (Constant shift of -4) as the others.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c28817482dab245ca34a9ed2c7d15bec309f9c5ed7d11cb8daa13bef502bdd09.png] 

The pattern followed here is

Option 1) S19 : O15 : K11

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/17534b786d1fed2bf1dd5f2f77fc04562c24fc9c47ef7f8e7e5482d57ed101a4.png] 

Option 2) N14 : J10 : F6

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c9b16754659a0c5295ff59d140c139385bd16c6b8b6cbd811923dc917e89e11f.png] 

Option 3) D4 : Z26 : V22

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/db46b4bfc21a2450293813514bfdd40634bd78fb6fd14cb168faa7f31c1928f3.png] 

Option 4) R18 : M13 : I9

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1b39a99e64b4f1bd35dedea461dbf4eb9324cc5143a8a33ed5f150271fbb18a4.png] 

Thus, out of all 'R18 : M13 : I9' is the odd one out.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4"**
